en.headline: Elderly woman dies after being struck by garbage truck in Kwai Chung
en.dek: An 80-year-old pedestrian pulling a handcart was hit on Hing Ning Road near Kwai Tsing Theatre this morning; the South Asian driver was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving causing death.
body: An 80-year-old woman was killed after being struck by a garbage truck on Hing Ning Road in Kwai Chung shortly after 10 a.m. on Friday. Police said the pedestrian was crossing from left to right in front of the vehicle near the Kwai Tsing Theatre when the truck failed to stop in time.

The woman, who was pulling a handcart loaded with cardboard, was thrown to the ground and certified dead at the scene by ambulance crews. The truck came to a halt further along Hing Fong Road; cardboard and the handcart were found trapped under the front of the vehicle. The South Asian male driver reported feeling unwell and was taken to hospital for checks.
Police arrested the driver on suspicion of dangerous driving causing death. The vehicle was towed away for examination and the case remains under investigation.

zh.headline: 葵涌垃圾車撞斃八旬女途人 司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 今早約10時10分興寧路近葵青劇院對開，垃圾車撞倒拉手推車過路的八旬婦，事主當場不治，南亞裔司機涉危險駕駛導致他人死亡被捕。
body: 今早約10時10分，一輛垃圾車在葵涌興寧路12號近葵青劇院對開，撞倒一名由左至右過路的八旬女途人。女事主正拉着手推車，車上載有紙皮，被撞後倒地昏迷，救護員到場檢驗後證實當場不治。
垃圾車撞人後繼續向前駛至興芳路始停下，車底近前胎位置仍夾有紙皮及手拉車。南亞裔男司機報稱不適，亦登上救護車送院檢查。警方經調查後，以涉嫌危險駕駛導致他人死亡將司機拘捕。
涉事垃圾車已被拖走扣驗，案件仍在調查中。死者女兒其後趕至現場認屍。
